discovery: A standing stone leans out of the roadside bracken, older than the road itself. Its carved face has worn to little more than a suggestion of grief, and the hollow beneath its base is slick with something dark that isn't rain.

choices.label: Search the Hollow
choices.description: Investigation check to search beneath the stone without disturbing it wrong

check.success_outcome: Your fingers close on a dagger of blackened silver, wedged into the stone by a hand centuries gone. It slides free without resistance, as though it had been waiting.
check.failure_outcome: You wrench something free, but it crumbles to wet ash between your fingers before you can see what it was. The stone seems to lean a little closer, disappointed.

choices.label: Walk On
choices.description: ESC also cancels - some graves are better left unread
